final_task_tree.title: Figure out a training plan for my dog
final_task_tree.description:
Rescue border collie mix, 14 months. Pulls hard on the leash and barks at every other dog on walks. South Bay, California; I can do evenings and weekends.

Three things only:
1. Whether to hire a trainer or do it myself.
2. If hiring — two or three local options with real prices.
3. A week-by-week plan for the first four weeks.

Don't research anything beyond those three.

comments.body:
Starting. Scoping to exactly the three things you asked for: (1) DIY vs hire recommendation, (2) 2-3 South Bay options with real prices, (3) a 4-week week-by-week plan. Nothing beyond that.

Breaking it into subtasks now so you can see the shape before I go digging.
comments.author: agent

subtasks.title: Decide: hire a trainer vs. DIY for leash pulling + dog reactivity
subtasks.description:
Deliverable: a clear recommendation with reasoning, written into this description.

Inputs to weigh: 14-month-old rescue border collie mix (adolescent, peak reactivity age), two specific problems — hard leash pulling and barking at every dog seen on walks. Owner has evenings and weekends available. South Bay CA.

Key question is whether barking-at-dogs is ordinary adolescent over-arousal (very DIY-able) or true reactivity/fear-based (usually benefits from a pro). Research what distinguishes them and what the general guidance is on DIY vs professional for each.

subtasks.title: Find 3 South Bay trainers with real prices for reactivity/leash work
subtasks.description:
Deliverable: 2-3 named local options with actual dollar figures, format (private/group/board), and whether they use positive-reinforcement / LIMA methods.

Constraints: South Bay California (San Jose, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Mountain View, Campbell, Los Gatos, Cupertino area). Owner available evenings and weekends only. Must handle leash reactivity toward other dogs.

Hard requirement: real prices, not 'contact us'. Fetch actual pricing pages. Note certifications (CPDT-KA, KPA, IAABC, CBCC-KA) since those matter for reactivity work.

subtasks.title: Write the 4-week week-by-week training plan
subtasks.description:
Deliverable: concrete week-by-week plan for weeks 1-4, sized for evenings + weekends.

Must cover both presenting problems: loose-leash walking and barking at other dogs. Should be specific enough to follow without further reading — named protocols, session lengths, frequency, equipment, and what success looks like at the end of each week.

Depends on: research into established protocols (engage-disengage, BAT, LAT, pattern games, threshold/distance management) and on standard loose-leash mechanics.
